method.reset_decisions: same visit/action opportunities; no automatic between-visit resets
method.forecast: production-engine parallel immutable counterfactuals; automatic buying; retained boost expiry; no future bonuses, claims or resets
method.forecast_objective: new Radiance over fixed horizon; reset must exceed retain by >1%
method.note_sinks: real12x100 dossier entries,5x50 plan slots,6x50 shared production decoration purchases
method.spending_order: strict sequential wish list; an unavailable first remaining item waits; dossier completion precedes next entry
method.marginal_sampling: reachable before-visit states near day7,30,60,89; exact one-unit gain includes target-tier synergy
limits: Virtual policies are not observed novice behavior, D30 retention or globally optimal reset advice.
Forecast horizons assume full-rate production for at most24h; later daily choices can invalidate the forecast.
Chapter, purchase and reconstruction times are upper bounds at action/evaluation boundaries.
Context tuples vary seed, day offset and start phase together; they test robustness, not independent causal seed effects.
Daily pursuing policy uses real reflection/season alternatives; it does not fabricate three completed contracts.
Extra plans are bought but their unused capacity does not automatically change purchase strategy.
Season pair checks engine separation; service, paid entitlement and UI account binding require independent coverage.
No human learning time, fill rates, beta readiness, release acceptance or elapsed season study is inferred.
